operation.summary: The opt-in on-phone vision engines for find and crop, from the Bridgit team's signed software manifest (checked daily, so new engines can appear without an app update): what each is good at, its speed and size on a mid-range phone, its licence, and whether its model is downloaded. They are free and work offline, and run only when you name them (engine, outline)
operation.returns: default_routing, manifest {serial, published_at, source bundled|downloaded, checked_at, signed_by, last_error}, engines [{engine, kind detector|outline, model, version, good_at, not_good_at, speed, memory, size_mb, licence, cost, installed, state ready|downloading|not_downloaded|waiting_for_wifi|failed|unsupported, kept_up_to_date, downloaded_mb, reason, how_to_use, runtime {model, size_mb, state}}]
